items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original 16:9 wide Japanese junior-high textbook illustration for K1-C5-S2, introduction to old folktales and classical literature. Scene: two Japanese first-year junior-high students, boy and girl in simple school uniforms, happily examining an open antique-looking Japanese picture book on a library desk. The large central book illustration clearly shows an ORIGINAL friendly Momotaro sailing toward a distant island with his dog, monkey and pheasant companions, inspired by Edo-era hand-painted picture-book texture, not copied from any existing artwork or modern character design. Make all four folktale companions distinguishable; small expressive humor in the monkey's curious look. The book must contain only pictures, no written characters, calligraphy, numerals or logos, including blank banner and bags. Warm approachable hand-drawn textbook style, soft bright blue/green/orange tones, rounded faces, simple clear composition, main book scene large and immediately understandable. No text, numbers, labels, speech-balloon text, watermark, frightening demons, violence or weapons. Produce a single finished image, not a grid of variants.
items.review: 桃太郎・犬・猿・キジが舟で島へ向かう絵本と、それを見る2人。文字・数値・既存作品の絵を写していないことを原本目視。衣装の桃模様は物語の意匠でブランドロゴではない。

items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original 16:9 wide scene illustration for a Japanese junior-high textbook, K1-C5-S3, The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter. The main central scene is an elderly bamboo cutter in simple historical Japanese work clothing, surprised and curious as he discovers ONE bamboo stalk glowing warmly at its root among a green bamboo grove. Keep the glow clearly at the ROOT, not the canopy. Friendly, peaceful expression; a woven collecting basket nearby. No violence or scary scene, no exposed weapon, no text or writing. Show the scene as a large picture on the open pages of an illustrated book that two modern Japanese first-year junior-high students in simple uniforms are reading together at the lower edge of the composition. The modern students stay outside the historic picture, never standing inside ancient Japan. Main old man and glowing bamboo large and readable, little playful curiosity in the two readers' faces. Soft bright hand-drawn watercolor/flat texture, rounded expressive characters, restrained green, blue and warm orange, simple background. The book is pictures only. Absolutely no letters, numerals, calligraphy, labels, logos, watermarks, printed paragraph lines, existing famous character design, modern objects in the historic grove or copied textbook art. Single completed image, no candidate grid.
items.review: 絵本の中の翁が根元の光る竹を見つける場面と、絵本の外の現代の生徒2人。時代が混在せず、根元の光・かご・文字なしを原本目視。
